tools.name: find_esim_plans
tools.description: Find current AeroCell travel eSIM plans for one country. Use a two-letter ISO country code. Provide both travel dates if known; plans covering the whole trip are returned by default. Optional data and USD price filters narrow results.

tools.name: get_esim_plan
tools.description: Get current details and an AeroCell checkout link for a plan ID from a single-country search. Requires the same country code.

tools.name: find_regional_esim_plans
tools.description: Find live multi-country AeroCell bundles. Supply every itinerary country as a two-letter ISO code; only bundles listing all those countries are returned. Optionally select a named region. A region-only search returns bundles with their exact country coverage.
